    Where did Pat Kelsey coach before Louisville?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Before becoming the head coach at Louisville in 2024, Pat Kelsey was the head coach at the
    College of Charleston (2021–2024) and Winthrop University (2012–2021). He also served as an assistant coach at Wake Forest and an associate head coach at Xavier University. 
    Kelsey’s career coaching stops before Louisville included: 
    • College of Charleston (Head Coach): 2021–2024, where he went 75-27 and led the team to two NCAA Tournaments.
    • Winthrop (Head Coach): 2012–2021, where he went 186-95, winning four Big South regular-season titles and making two NCAA Tournament appearances.
    • Xavier (Associate Head Coach): 2009–2011, working under Chris Mack.
    • Wake Forest
      (Assistant Coach/DOBO):
      2001–2009, working under Skip Prosser and Dino Gaudio.
       
    He is known for his successful rebuilding projects, leading both Winthrop and Charleston to conference titles and NCAA tournament berths.
